def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    current_prices = [150, 152, 151, 153, 155]
    prior_prices = [148, 149, 150, 151, 152]
    period1 = 25
    period2 = 13

    # Calculate price changes and absolute price changes
    price_changes = [
        current - prior
        for current, prior in zip(current_prices, prior_prices)
    ]
    absolute_price_changes = [abs(change) for change in price_changes]

    def calculate_ema(values, period):
        ema = [values[0]]
        multiplier = 2 / (period + 1)

        for value in values[1:]:
            ema.append((value - ema[-1]) * multiplier + ema[-1])

        return ema

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    pcs_ema = calculate_ema(price_changes, period1)
    apc_ema = calculate_ema(absolute_price_changes, period1)

    pcds_ema = calculate_ema(pcs_ema, period2)
    apcds_ema = calculate_ema(apc_ema, period2)

    tsi = (pcds_ema[-1] / apcds_ema[-1]) * 100

    # return answer rounded to two decimal places
    return round(tsi, 2)
